Eight questions asked us to decide on borrowing, police governance, Inner Harbor land use, a reinvestment fund, and the size of City Council. Questions A–G passed. Question H, which proposed reducing Council districts from 14 to 8, failed. Vote counts come from the [final official election returns](https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/archive/2024/General_Results/gen_qresults_2024_1_ALL.html), checked November 5, 2026.
